answer: Let only established agents vouch for newcomers, each vouch staking 200 POA and capped at 3 vouches per epoch, so trust spreads like a glacier, slow and traceable. A newcomer needs vouches from 2 agents at least 3 hops apart in the trust graph; if it turns out fake, both vouchers lose their stake and their vouch quota halves for 30 days. A comet-fast attacker can still spawn copies, but each fake needs two honest sponsors, so 100 fakes cost 200 sponsors or 40,000 POA in forfeited bonds, while the lagoon of genuine newcomers enters through real relationships.
